name: codepatchbay
description: Local delivery runtime for coding agents with ACP orchestration, evidence tracking, and reviewable artifacts.

scripts.pretest:node: npm run build:node && npm run build:tests
scripts.test:live: npm run build:node && npm run build:tests && node dist-tests/scripts/run-node-tests.js --live
scripts.test:agent-subsystem: node dist-tests/scripts/run-node-tests.js tests/dynamic-agent-plan.test.ts tests/session-cache-lifecycle.test.ts tests/session-pin.test.ts tests/agent-isolation.test.ts
scripts.verify:stabilization: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node dist/scripts/verify-stabilization.js
scripts.verify:release-contracts: npm run build:node && npm run build:tests && node dist/scripts/verify-release-contracts.js
scripts.build:node: test -f tsconfig.node.json && test -f scripts/write-dist-metadata.ts && test -f scripts/build-output.mjs || { echo "build:node must run from the source checkout; refusing to remove dist" >&2; exit 1; } && node scripts/build-output.mjs node
scripts.build:tests: test -f tsconfig.tests.json && test -f tsconfig.node.json && test -f scripts/build-output.mjs || { echo "build:tests must run from the source checkout; refusing to remove dist-tests" >&2; exit 1; } && node scripts/build-output.mjs tests
scripts.verify:p0p1: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node dist/scripts/verify-p0-p1.js
scripts.verify:enterprise-gate: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node dist/scripts/verify-enterprise-gate.js
scripts.verify:release-gate: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node dist/scripts/verify-release-gate.js
